name: Yakuza: Japan's Mafia
overview:
A Journey into the World of Crime

: Despite facing anti-crime laws in 2010, the Japanese Yakuza remain active. Their name reflects the concept of "losers," and their history dates back to the 8th century when they began working in dice games. Yakuza members are distinguished by painful tattoos and impoverished origins, which provide them with a means of social advancement and respect. Their leader in Tokyo's Asakusa district embodies the legacy of organized crime.
